title: Hope That Does Not Disappoint
opening: Christian hope is rooted in God’s faithfulness. It does not deny hardship; it gives us strength to face hardship with patience and support.
points: Remember the ways God has sustained you in the past.
Stay connected to people who can pray with you and offer practical help.
Let hope lead to patient action, not promises that every problem will disappear instantly.
reflection: What source of godly encouragement can you return to today?
prayer: God of hope, fill me with joy and peace as I trust You. Help me encourage others and persevere with wisdom. Amen.
